extension.description: The shared object file for the YAC extension.

yac.maxfilesize.description: Maximum file size in bytes that can be cached. Files larger than this are skipped.

yac.maxentries.description: Maximum number of entries in the shared memory segment.

yac.compress.description: Whether to compress cached values using gzip.

yac.ttl.description: Time-to-live for cached entries in seconds.

yac.skip_large_files.description: Skip caching files larger than this size (0 means no limit).
